```{r}
library(leapR)
```

```{r}
data("ncipid")
```


```{r}
ncipid_overview <- as.tibble(
  ncipid$matrix[1:5, 1:20]
) %>%
  add_column(pathway = ncipid$names[1:5], .before = 1) %>%
  add_column(size = ncipid$sizes[1:5], .after = 1)

t(ncipid_overview)
```

```{r}
a4b7 <- c("ITGA4", "PXN", "ITGB7", "RHOA", "MADCAM1", "VACM1")
other_prots <- t(ncipid$matrix)[, 2:3] %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ na_if(., "null"))) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ na_if(., ""))) %>%
  unlist() %>%
  unname() %>%
  as.vector()

other_prots <- na.omit(other_prots)
other_prots
```


```{r}
msigdbr_df <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", subcollection = "CP:PID") %>%
  select(gs_name, gene_symbol) %>%
  distinct()
msigdbr_list <- split(x = msigdbr_df$gene_symbol, f = msigdbr_df$gs_name)
```

```{r}
write_gmt <- function(gene_list, filename) {
  # Open file connection
  con <- file(filename, "w")

  for (set_name in names(gene_list)) {
    genes <- gene_list[[set_name]]
    # GMT format requires: Name, Description (or NA), followed by genes
    row_data <- c(set_name, "NA", genes)
    # Write as a tab-separated line
    writeLines(paste(row_data, collapse = "\t"), con)
  }

  close(con)
}
```

```{r}
write_gmt(msigdbr_list, "msigdbr_list.gmt")
```

```{r}
pid_pathways <- leapR::read_gene_sets("msigdbr_list.gmt")
```
